lines.note: The companion/Pleasure and Jerusalem/armies clauses divide Greek verse 4.
Shared hair and lips clauses link these divisions: Ge'ez 6 spans Greek 5-6, and Ge'ez 7 spans Greek 6-7.
The dove and mother/praise clauses divide Greek verse 9; Ge'ez adds silver wings and golden plumage.
Matches dawn, moon, sun, and armies; Ge'ez adds a clause about her mysterious movements.
The summons to return, Shulamite, has no counterpart in the supplied Greek chapter.
